title: Free cash flow decline driven by capex
question: What happened to free cash flow between FY2024 and FY2025, and what drove it?

gold_answer.summary: Free cash flow fell 25.0%, from GBP 800k to GBP 600k. Operating cash flow actually improved by GBP 300k (+25.0%), but capital expenditure more than doubled, rising GBP 500k (+125.0%), which more than offset it.
gold_answer.main_driver: Capital expenditure more than doubled; operating cash generation improved.

design_note: Baseline. Tests whether the model separates operating performance (improving) from investment spending (the cause of the decline), rather than describing the fall as a deterioration in the business. The table does not say what the capex was for, so any stated purpose is a grounding failure.
